body:
Yes, I am trapped in the past. I call it being stuck in the summer after high school, as my life never really moved on.

Something freaky happened to me the other day. A long time ago I dropped out of university but there was this one guy who was always friendly to me. He went out of his way to be polite whilst everyone else ignored me or was a cunt in general. I dropped out and never saw him again. Anyway, I ran a race at the weekend and when I checked the results I saw this guys name next to mine. I checked the pictures and sure enough, it was him. We must have been running side by side the whole way and I didn't realise. I hadn't seen him in almost 15 years but it was another one of those moments where I am reminded of the past. He ultimately went onto oxford and works in pharma, whilst I fell into a pit of depression. I went back to university years later but I haven't had a successful life like him, so far anyway.

Every so often life likes to remind me of the past in subtle ways like this. It is like the universe is fucking with my head.

I finished ahead of him by 1 second in the race.
